The '''heavy repeating blaster''' was a large and powerful variant of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].

==Description==
The heavy repeating blasters were mainly used in bunker emplacements or mounted on combat vehicles,<ref name="TRG1" /> though it could also be wielded by individuals.

The gun could only be used at a rapid fire rate. In its conventional usage, it would often be attached to a [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] to provide an unlimited number of shots, however it could also function with a portable [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] giving it a capacity of 20 shots. The accuracy of the blaster as a personal use weapon was very limited, owing to the difficulty in controlling such a powerful autofire gun. When mounted on a tripod, the weapon became slightly easier to operate.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

Like all other kind of [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]], the heavy variant was issued only to military use. They were designed for infantry support.<ref name="TRG1" />

==History==
[[Canderous Ordo]] owned and carried [[Ordo's Repeating Blaster|a prototype heavy repeater]] during the [[Old Sith Wars]].<ref name="Kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

Heavy repeating blasters were used by the specially trained [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] called [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC Troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> They were also used by the heavy weapon specialists of the Rebel [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] during the [[Rebellion era]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" /> The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had a heavy repeating blaster installed on the ventral side as a surface defense cannon.<ref name="TRG1" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[E522 assassin droid/Legends|E522 assassin droid]] sported a heavy repeating blaster among its arsenal.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
